card.name: Section cross-reference numbers in labels
card.fires_on: The decimal point inside a bracketed section number like (5.9) in highlights text, and the word Usage after "Indications and" in a see-section reference.

modes.label: Decimal in section number
modes.description: The period between the two digits of a warnings section reference in parentheses.

modes.label: Usage after Indications and
modes.description: The word Usage completing the cross-referenced heading Indications and Usage.

card.plain: It marks the spot inside a label's cross-reference to another section, such as (5.6) or Indications and Usage.
